name: Matobo Hills
description: Just south of Bulawayo in Zimbabwe, the Matobo Hills are a landscape of giant granite domes and balanced boulders, shaped over some two billion years. The gaps and overhangs between the rocks have sheltered people since the early Stone Age, and many are covered in ancient paintings. Local communities still use the hills' shrines and sacred places today, and the park also shelters white rhinos.
